div.p: Progressing means wait. Degraded means a human is needed.

A model whose pods are fine but which no policy covers reports Degraded, even though the CRD calls it Pending — it will never fix itself. Likewise an ImagePullBackOff or Unschedulable LLMInferenceService is Degraded, while a model still loading its weights is Progressing.

div.h3: Install the health checks before the first sync
div.p: Without them Argo CD reports every MaaSModelRef, MaaSAuthPolicy, MaaSSubscription, ExternalModel and LLMInferenceService Healthy the instant it is created — whether or not the model ever serves a request. One oc patch; step 1 of the README.

text.tspan: governed, but runtime failing = live outage
